proves.claim: clause 1: reserveItem records holder, by and at, and a second reservation replaces the first.

moves.reserve-item.records-holder-by-at-.why: A reservation that is not recorded, or that stacks, would misroute the item.

proves.claim: clause 2: an engine below RESERVATION_ENGINE refuses reserveItem with ENGINE_VERSION.

moves.reserve-item.older-engine-refuses.why: Older boards must replay without ever seeing a reservation.
